verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs describe linking between objects. They say users can 'trace how ideas relate, see what's connected', and that links appear in the Knowledge Graph, so the core linking capability exists. The evidence does not show [[wiki-style]] syntax, a dedicated backlinks panel with in-context snippets, or unlinked-mention detection. Missing for 10: [[double-bracket]] link syntax, an explicit backlinks list shown in context, unlinked mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can link notes with [[wiki-style]] links and see every backlink and unlinked mention of a note in context

citations.quote: Linking on Anytype is what turns a bunch of separate notes into a connected knowledge base.
You can trace how ideas relate, see what's connected to a project
This relationship is registered in Anytype as a link and becomes visible in your Knowledge Graph
